description.value: Café Crêpe is a French-style crêperie making crepes from homemade batter since 1999, located steps from the Granville SkyTrain Station entrance in the heart of downtown Vancouver. The menu spans a wide range of savoury and sweet crêpes alongside specialty illy espresso drinks, milkshakes, and French sodas, with a gluten-free buckwheat crêpe substitution available on any item. Both indoor and outdoor seating are on offer, making it a convenient refuelling stop on a downtown cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the primary evidence source and reveals two significant discrepancies with OSM: the address (OSM: 796 Granville St vs. website: 672 Granville Street adjacent to Granville Station) and phone number (OSM: +1-604-806-0834 vs. website: (604) 336-3637); website values are treated as current and authoritative. Vegetarian options and gluten-free buckwheat crêpe substitution are confirmed from the menu; OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:vegan=no. Takeout and delivery are confirmed via explicit Ritual and DoorDash references on the website; bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, and most other amenities are not mentioned in either the website content or OSM tags.
